port_difficulty.why: Ten lines, no arithmetic, but it CALLs a program whose name is read at run time by ACCEPT, so the port needs a run-time program registry and the callee set is not in the tree.

blast_radius.why: Its callee is chosen by run-time input, so it can start any program on the load library, including one on the nightly batch cycle; the tree has no JCL to show what feeds it, and the failure would surface only for the input values that hit a missing or renamed target.

units.driving_fact: CALL WS-PGM-NAME at line 9 takes a name that only ACCEPT at line 8 sets, so its reach cannot be bounded from source.

port_difficulty.why: Four lines: PROGRAM-ID then GOBACK. No data, no logic.

blast_radius.why: It does nothing and touches no data; it is one of the programs PROGA could dispatch to, but nothing in the tree calls it by name.
